text:
maya: Quick question — we're seeing authz attribution flip when routing requests from org-level API keys. Some prod customers report project attribution jumping between org and project during failover. Anyone run into this?
sam: I saw something similar on the canary last week. Sounds like token-affinity fallback in the auth-proxy. Is this happening at the edge or in the internal proxy?
maya: edge. Our current rule prefers project keys, else fall back to org. But when proxy retries/replays requests we sometimes lose the origin_project header and end up attributing to the org.
kevin: +1. Telemetry shows 'origin_project' attr drop correlates with 429 retries and proxy retries. Retry path may be normalizing headers. Two options: make attribution sticky across retries or attach an immutable parent_id claim to tokens.
toni: From a console UX angle we should surface the effective attribution per request sample. Also show the decision reason: 'explicit project key' vs 'org fallback' vs 'proxy-impersonation'. That'll help support. :eyes:
alex: Rollout concerns — if attribution flips it can affect quotas/billing. We need a canary plan and alerts for sudden project quota changes.
maya: Thinking heuristic tweak: prefer explicit token.project if token has project claim AND headers.x-origin-project matches. Else, preserve previous attribution if it's a retry. Pseudocode:
```
if token.project && headers.x-origin-project == token.project:
  attribution = token.project
else if previous_attrib and is_retry:
  attribution = previous_attrib
else:
  attribution = org_id
```
Would that open a security hole?
sam: We must NOT trust arbitrary headers. Only accept x-origin-project if header is signed by our auth-proxy (header-signature) or verified via shared secret. Also emit telemetry tag `auth.attribution.reason` with values like explicit|signed-header|fallback.
kevin: Agree on signed header. Also record `auth.attribution.path` (edge|proxy|direct) and `auth.retry.count`. Those fields will help debug rate-limit loops and attribution flips.
toni: Dashboard asks: add widgets — attribution distribution (24h), top tenants with attribution flips, and a sample-traces link from each row. Make those drilldowns clickable.
maya: Can console show raw headers + token claims in the sample drilldown? That would be really useful for debugging.
console-bot: New deploy: auth-proxy header-signing landed to canary group 'authz-heuristics' (rev c12). CI: green. :rocket:
alex: Let's loop in security to validate header-signing algorithm (HMAC vs signed JWT). Also need a billing migration plan so owners get notified if attribution changes for high-spend projects.
sam: I'll open a tracking issue with acceptance criteria: signed header check, telemetry events (`auth.attribution.reason`, `auth.attribution.path`, `auth.retry.count`), dashboard widgets, canary plan (10% -> 50% -> 100%) and alerting for attribution jitter.
maya: Thanks. Drafting a short RFC now. Plan: enable signed header check in canary (10%), collect telemetry for 48h, validate no unexpected quota shifts, then widen. Will ping ops before each ramp. :thumbsup:
